C0202.title: Jiangsu Suqian: Zong and Others Used Bot Farm Software to Inflate Livestream and Fan Circle Metrics
C0202.summary: Typical online-water-army cases released by the Ministry of Public Security included a Suqian, Jiangsu case involving Zong and others. Zong and his associates set up a studio, purchased multiple group-control software tools and large numbers of phones, illegally controlled many online accounts, and long provided paid fake reposts, likes, comments, and other traffic-manipulation services for livestreaming and fan-circle groups.
